current_text.html:
The Agencies are:

Covenant College (CC)

Covenant Theological Seminary (CTS)

PCA Foundation (PCAF)

Geneva Benefits Group (Geneva)

Ridge Haven Conference Center (RH)

The relationship of the Agencies to the Assembly remains as a Committee, although they may be incorporated separately for civil purposes. The composition and responsibilities of the Agencies are set forth in the Bylaws.

relationships.title: SJC member eligibility for concurrent GA agency board service

occurrences.excerpt: The CCB advised that a member of the GA's Standing Judicial Commission is eligible to serve concurrently on the board of a General Assembly agency.

relationships.title: Permanent Committee Members on Committees of Commissioners

occurrences.excerpt: The CCB clarified that the "permanent committee" ineligibility provision in RAO 13-2 applies only to the four committees enumerated in RAO 4-2, not to other GA entities.
